label: Atomic radius
undefined_note: Noble-gas radii are measured on a different basis and are not comparable.

label: Electronegativity
undefined_note: Most noble gases form no ordinary bonds, so the Pauling scale assigns them no value.

label: Valence electrons
undefined_note: Valence electrons equal the column only for main-group elements; a d-block card has no column.

label: Electron affinity
undefined_note: This element does not form a stable negative ion, so it has no comparable electron affinity.

label: Ionic radius
undefined_note: This element has no common simple ion with a comparable six-coordinate radius.
